notes:
📦 eBay consignment (new Consign tab):
• Take a customer's cards to sell on eBay — from the offer (Draft → 📦 Consign on eBay) or by hand. Each card gets its own tag (CN1001-03, barcode) with a list price and the customer's lowest price
• 🔒 Put in safe → 🛒 Listed (eBay link) → 💵 Sold (buyer paid, eBay fees, shipping) → Pay out (cash, check, Venmo, PayPal) or ↩ Return to customer
• Store keeps 20% of what's left after eBay fees + shipping, at least $5 a card (Rates & terms, manager PIN; a different rate on one consignment needs the PIN too). Every consignment keeps the rate it was taken in at
• Prints: signed agreement (customer + store copy), card tags, payout slip with signature, consignment safe sheet
• Alerts for cards not in the safe yet, payouts overdue and cards unsold too long; ✉ Tell the customer (sold / status / not sold) by email or copy for a text
